title: WHOLE HEART
tagline: Thank Him with all your heart.
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: I will give thanks to you, Lord, with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonderful deeds.

session.prompt: Name what you're most thankful for right now and tell God plainly.
Let your thanks become praise for the God who is good.

coaching_notes: During today's session, be mindful of any areas of your heart where you may be struggling to thank God. What would it look like for those to change?
